samples.title: Akki Roti
instructions: Bring together rice flour and onion with salt, spice, and just enough moisture for the dough or bread base.
Knead or fold until it feels soft, then rest briefly so it rolls without tearing.
Shape into even portions and roll or pat them without making the edges too thick.
Roast on a hot tawa or toast in a pan, adding ghee or oil only as needed.
Turn until both sides are cooked through, then finish hot with curd, chutney, or pickle.

samples.title: Milk Toast
instructions: Bring together bread, milk and sugar or jaggery with salt, spice, and just enough moisture for the dough or bread base.
Knead or fold until it feels soft, then rest briefly so it rolls without tearing.
Assemble the filling evenly and press or roll it so every bite is balanced.
Roast on a hot tawa or toast in a pan, adding ghee or oil only as needed.
Turn until both sides are cooked through, then finish hot with curd, chutney, or pickle.

samples.title: Aloo Paratha
instructions: Bring together wheat and potato with salt, spice, and just enough moisture for the dough or bread base.
Knead or fold until it feels soft, then rest briefly so it rolls without tearing.
Shape into even portions and roll or pat them without making the edges too thick.
Roast on a hot tawa or toast in a pan, adding ghee or oil only as needed.
Turn until both sides are cooked through, then finish hot with curd, chutney, or pickle.

samples.title: Andhra Chicken Curry
instructions: Prep Chicken, Onion and Red Chilli and keep Curry Leaves ready before heating the pan.
Heat oil or ghee, then sauté the aromatics until they soften and turn fragrant.
Roast the spices or masala paste until the raw smell fades.
Build the masala patiently; this is where the regional flavor deepens.
Add the main ingredients and turn them through the masala so they are well coated.
Pour in the liquid, cover, and simmer gently until the curry cooks through.
Keep the simmer gentle so the sauce thickens without breaking.
Adjust salt, sourness, and heat, then let the gravy rest for a few minutes.
Garnish and serve Andhra Chicken Curry with the pairing that best suits its Andhra style character.

samples.title: Andhra Egg Fry
instructions: Prep Egg and Chilli and keep Onion, Curry Leaves, Garlic and Ginger ready so the snack comes together quickly.
Toss the ingredients with the spice mix until everything is evenly coated.
Fry or shallow-fry in steady heat until the outside turns crisp and golden.
Drain or rest briefly, then sprinkle the final seasoning while it is still warm.
Serve immediately so Andhra Egg Fry keeps its best texture.

samples.title: Andhra Kodi Vepudu
instructions: Prep Chicken and Chilli and keep Onion, Curry Leaves, Garlic and Ginger ready so the snack comes together quickly.
Toss the ingredients with the spice mix until everything is evenly coated.
Fry or shallow-fry in steady heat until the outside turns crisp and golden.
Drain or rest briefly, then sprinkle the final seasoning while it is still warm.
Serve immediately so Andhra Kodi Vepudu keeps its best texture.

samples.title: Andhra Podi Idli
instructions: Bring the batter or grain base to a soft, workable consistency for Andhra Podi Idli.
Prepare Idli Rice and Urad Dal and keep Podi and Ghee ready for filling, topping, or tempering.
Grease the moulds and steam until the centers feel set.
Cook until the edges lift cleanly and the surface is tender or crisp as intended.
Rest for a minute, then serve with chutney, sambar, or a simple side.

samples.title: Appam
instructions: Bring the fermented rice-coconut batter to a loose, pourable consistency for Appam.
Keep rice, coconut and yeast and sugar ready so the batter tastes balanced before it hits the pan.
Heat the tawa well, spread the batter evenly, and drizzle a little oil around the edges.
Cook until the edges lift cleanly and the surface is tender or crisp as intended.
Rest for a minute, then serve with chutney, sambar, or a simple side.

samples.title: Apple Puree
instructions: Prep apple and milk and keep the aromatics ready so the snack comes together quickly.
Toss the ingredients with the spice mix until everything is evenly coated.
